draft.body:
I came across the post you shared about the boy who became the first patient to receive that proton therapy treatment, and it stuck with me. It is one thing to read about medical technology in the abstract and another to see what it actually does for a real kid and his family.

I am Justin, I recently graduated with an M.S. in Computer Engineering from RIT. Most of my hands on background is Linux based systems work and robotic manipulators, writing and deploying services on embedded Linux and develop perception system devices and putting together along with documenting and prepare a BOM during past internships. I saw the Software Engineering Support Specialist opening at Mevion and it lines up closely with that kind of work.

Since you work in People Operations there, I was hoping you could point me toward whoever is handling that role, or let me know if there is a better person for me to speak with. Happy to share more about my background if that would help.
draft.hook_used: she reposted a story about a boy receiving Mevion proton therapy treatment as the first patient
